name: Selecting the context a planner reads
vision_statement: The material a planner reads before it plans, whether a card, a file, a conversation or a specification record, is the material the request concerns, however the request is worded.
opportunities: Which material a planner reads is a retrieval problem with its own alternatives and its own public evidence, which the parent solution does not weigh: lexical, vector and hybrid rankers over a person's cards, files and conversations, a ranker per representative, references that must resolve to current text without failing a turn, and one ranking that holds the cards and the specification records of a repository together so a run also sees when no solution covers its request. Public benchmarks of similar rankers are shown beside the measurements made here.
solution_coherence: select-context chooses the cards, files and conversations a planner reads before it plans, so the right material is found however a request is worded. It follows the pointer of a card to the person's current notes and files through resolve-references, and it searches the cards and the specification records of a repository in one ranking through search-cards-and-specs.
